description:
Create a point map in Epi Info 7 showing the locations of positive West Nile Virus mosquito pools in Chicago. 

1. Open the 'Epi Map' module.
2. Add a Data Layer using the file 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\Chicago_WNV_Tests.csv'.
3. Ensure Latitude and Longitude fields are mapped correctly.
4. Apply a Filter to show ONLY records where RESULT is 'positive'.
5. Save the map as an image file named 'wnv_positive_map.png' in the 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\' folder.
